svg.title: OPAL database schema
svg.desc: Entity diagram of the OPAL database grouped into reference catalogue, planning, data collection and post-processing.
svg.text: The plan, the on-site record and the annotation now share keys. Nothing is matched up by hand afterwards.
What the planner builds from the modelling team's standards
What the operator records on site, offline first
Matching scans to files, review, annotation
Main path: project → collection → planned run → log → scan → annotation
Reference link (dot marks the parent) · → names a table in another group
Users, audit columns and API bookkeeping tables omitted · dc_ = data_collection_ · pp_ = post_processing_
